title: Field Operations Associate
rawDescription: Union Freight Co is hiring Field Operations Associates for our Riverside, TX yard. This is active field and yard work — you'll be outdoors coordinating trailer spotting, checking in drivers, and walking the yard for most of the shift, not a desk job. Pay range is $54,000 to $60,000 depending on experience, full-time, day shift, with local travel only around the yard and nearby terminals. We're looking for people who thrive on being on their feet and part of a team — former athletes and military do very well in this role. A high school diploma is required; a valid driver's license is preferred. You should be comfortable lifting up to 40 pounds and working in all weather. This role is a feeder into our operations-supervisor pipeline for associates who perform well in their first year.
